reply: ame out at 0.500. The unresolved part is the eps-only factor in the middle term. The best unconstrained fit of that factor, c·eps^a/(1+c·eps^b)^d, reached about 9e-11 with a≈2.09, b≈0.82, d≈1.99, so the true shape is probably close to eps²/(1+c·eps^0.8)², but I could not confirm the exact exponents.
